p: this side Jordan in the wilderness: In the country of Moab.
over against the Red sea: So that the wilderness was between the sea and the plain of Moab.

Horeb by the way of mount: In Horeb, or Sinai, forty years before the law was given: but because all that were then of age and judgment were now dead, Moses repeats the same to the youth who either then were not born, or had not judgment.
Sihon the king of the Amorites: By these examples of God's favour, their minds are prepared to receive the law.
began Moses to declare this law: The second time.
Horeb: In the second year and second month, Nu 10:11.
unto you at that time: By the counsel of Jethro my father-in-law, Ex 18:19.
multiplied you: Not so much by the course of nature, as miraculously.
bear your cumbrance: Signifying how great a burden it is, to govern the people.
known among your tribes: Whose godliness and uprightness is known.
wise men: Declaring what sort of men ought to have a public charge, read Ex 18:21.
God's: You are his Lieutenants.
I said unto you: So that the fault was in themselves, that they did not sooner possess the inheritance promised.
And ye came near unto me: Read Nu 13:3.
said: That is, Caleb, and Joshua; Moses prefers the better part to the greater, that is, two to ten.
hated us: Such was the Jews unthankfulness, that they counted God's special love, hatred.
brethren have discouraged our heart: The other ten, not Caleb and Joshua.
which goeth before you: Declaring that to renounce our own force, and constantly to follow our calling, and depend on the Lord, is true boldness, and agreeable to God.
before thee: Who minister to you.
little ones: Who were under twenty years of age, Nu 14:31.
we will go up and fight: This declares man's nature, who will do that which God forbids, and will not do that which he commands.
not among you: Signifying that man has no strength, but when God is at hand to help him.
hearken to your voice: Because you rather showed your hypocrisy, than true repentance; rather lamenting the loss of your brethren, than repenting for your sins.
